description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible** 

  
  

## ABOUT THE COMPANY:

BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases is a regional development and investment joint venture (JV) between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra “APQ”. Our company benefits from the combined strengths of two leading entities. BHIG is positioned to drive industrial innovation and operational excellence across Saudi Arabia and the region. BHIG focuses on supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production.  
  
**Reimagine What’s Possible**  
  
The HYCO Lead Operator, reporting to the HYCO Shift Supervisor, is accountable for the day-to-day DCS & Field Operation of HYCO facility, ensuring the production requirements set by the customer are achieved. HYCO Lead Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient and stable operation of the entire Hydrogen Manufacturing Unit from a centralized control room using DCS. This includes monitoring, controlling and optimizing to meet production targets, quality specifications and environmental regulations. This includes actively supporting plant performance, process optimization and production stability while maintaining strong focus on safety & compliance. The HYCO Lead Operator will execute daily tasks which include preparing and implementing safety work permits, LOTO, completing operations preventative maintenance activities, and assist the maintenance and engineering teams in preparing and executing corrective maintenance activities. Lead operator will handle the Shift lead responsibility in absence of Shift supervisor ensuring the business continuity.

  
**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:**  
  
**Safety, Health & Environment**

* Maintain a safe & stable environment. Demonstrate leadership with all Company & Industry safe work processes to prevent all injuries. Ensure proper documentation is maintained for safety related activities.
* Enforce and adhere to all Safe Work Permits and Lock-out Tag-out and management of change procedures.
* Be the first line of response for process emergencies. Execute emergency operating procedures, initiate plant trips if necessary and direct field operators.
* Monitor status of Safety Instrumented System (SIS) and Fire & Gas Systems. Understand the cause & effect chart for all safety interlocks.
* Ensure all plant emissions (from reformer stack, vent streams) comply with environmental permits. Properly manage waste streams.
* Ensure the safety of all operations personnel by utilizing the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program  
    

**Technical & Operations**

* Operate the Steam Methane Reformer based hydrogen plant with CO2 Removal section & CO2 compression, PSA with Tail Gas compression, Membrane Unit and related utilities as prescribed by the Work Instruction Procedures
* Operate the pipeline network to supply Hydrogen, steam and CO2 to customers’ pipelines safely and efficiently.
* Report production progress and plant status to the Shift Supervisor and suggest solutions for any shortfalls. Manage plant production efficiently based on input provided by Plant Management to ensure safety and reliability targets are met to achieve maximum profitability.
* Ensure BHIG standards, and global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and overall customer services are met.
* Meet the customer’s requirements regarding safety, reliability, product quality, and flexibility regarding product supply. Maintain customer communications and relationships at the ‘board’ level, ensuring customer demand rates are satisfied while maximizing the efficiency and profitability of the facility.
* Follow the Site Work Instruction Manuals for production & supply of Product H2, CO2 & Steam along with other operating and maintenance procedures and checklists to meet the customer’s satisfaction with safety, reliability, product quality, and flexibility of product supply while compliance with requirements.
* Maintain a relationship with the customer’s counterparts from other Refinery Units where from BHIG either receiving Feedstock, Utilities & Power or supplying Hydrogen and Steam to different Refinery Units on a regular basis through Refinery Shift Superintendent to ensure alignment of expectations for BHIG and the customers current and future product demand.
* Constantly monitor all process variables (flows, temperatures, pressures, levels, analytical values) via DCS to ensure they are within defined operating limits.
* Manipulate control loops, setpoints and cascades to maintain sable operations of all integrated units.
* Use historical data and trends to predict equipment performance degradation, identify inefficiencies and prevent potential trips and failures.
* Execute & supervise the detailed start up sequence for the entire plant or individual units/loops form a cold condition, warm condition or hot stand by condition, ensuring a smooth & safe transition to full load normal operations. Assist in the commissioning activities of the facility
* Maintain constant communication with field operators, providing instructions for equipment adjustments, isolations and rounds.
* Liaise with the maintenance team to co-ordinate equipment preparation for maintenance (isolation, purging & blinding) and safe taking equipment back in line.
* Conduct detailed and accurate shift handovers with incoming operators, highlighting any abnormalities, ongoing work and special instruction. Follow shift turnover protocols to ensure a safe and efficient handover to the following shift.
* Maintain accurate and timely logs of operating parameters, significant events and production data. Fully accountable to ensure his logs and that his operator’s logs are accurate and compliant with published matrix.
* Identify the root cause of process deviations and equipment malfunction. Work with engineers to implement long-term solutions.
* Suggest and participate in operational improvements and de-bottlenecking projects to enhance safety, reliability and profitability.
* Ensure compliance with all CM, PM tasks & Environmental Regulatory requirements.
* Support and prepare for Shutdown Planning and Turnaround Planning.
* Provide coaching and motivation with the field operations team to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
* Establish & maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor & evaluate plant systems & equipment performance.
* Ensure compliance with process safety, MOC’s, and OPHR requirements.
* Provide operations support and participate in investigations and Root Cause Analysis to identify & implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Facilitate attainment of operational excellence and customer satisfaction via operations productivity, reliability, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Communication of plant activities with other shifts to maintain continuity between shifts for a safe and reliable operation.
* Execute other duties as assigned by reporting managers in a timely and efficient manner.  
    

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical, Mechanical, or Chemical Process Operations with 10 years’ experience preferred. An Associate Technical Degree (2-year certificate) will be considered based on years of experience and competence.
* Experience in DCS Operation & Field Operation, with minimum of 5 years’ Lead DCS Operations
* Experience in SMR based Hydrogen or Ammonia or Methanol or Syngas plant as DCS Operator.
* Proficiency with DCS platforms (e.g. Yokogawa Centum VP, Siemens PCS 7)
* Deep understanding of Chemical Engineering Principles, thermodynamics and process control. Wide technical knowledge in operations, engineering, and maintenance activities
* Ability to maintain high level of awareness and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Strong problem solving and diagnostic abilities.
* Clear, concise and effective verbal and written communication. Proficiency in English speaking and writing. Ability to communicate with the customer at the board level daily. Able to communicate between operations and maintenance teams.
* Deep understanding of Chemical Engineering Principles, thermodynamics and process control
* A strong commitment to employee involvement, team building and diversity.

description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible** 

  
  

**PURPOSE**

To ensure the safe, reliable, efficient and sustainable operations of the BHIG rotating equipment. Managing the rotating maintenance activities with the Planner, Operations, and Engineering teams and is responsible for coordinating, organizing, and executing the PM overhauls and preventative and corrective maintenance activities. The aim is to reduce maintenance related costs while improving plant reliability and availability, in line with business needs for facilities which range across multiple technologies such as Air Separation (ASU), Steam Methane reformer (HYCO), and CO2, along with ancillary equipment to support the facility.

**NATURE & SCOPE**

The Rotating Equipment Specialist reporting to the Maintenance Manager is accountable for the safe and reliable operations for all the rotating equipment in the JIGH, SATORP and SASREF sites.

The position requires the management of a team of Technicians to achieve a high maintenance standard by providing day-to-day support, safe and effective execution and support the reliable and efficient operation of our rotating equipment. Execute all the preventative and corrective maintenance activities for all sites with the intention of improving the MTBF, MTTR and reliability of the rotating equipment. Lead and co-ordinate the activities with service providers and ensure that all protocols, QCPs and standards are conducted and achieved. Act as an SME for rotating equipment root cause analysis and maintenance strategy development and optimization. Technical report writing and the ability to clearly and articulately explain to Senior Management is a requirement. The coaching and mentoring of the junior Technicians on rotating equipment maintenance practices is required with hands on execution.  The position will work closely with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure the scope of work is executed safely and reliably. Ensure that the critical spares have sufficient quantity, refurbished to the correct standard, preserved correctly, and are as specified on delivery. 

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**SAFETY**

* Provide and maintain a safe work environment.
* Demonstrate leadership with company and industry safe work practices to prevent injuries.
* Ensure proper implementation and documentation is maintained for safety related activities.
* Complete a comprehensive and value-added risk assessment or JSA depending on the risk factor, nature and complexity of the task.
* Conduct APTs and lead safety investigations and improvements regarding rotating equipment.
* Ensure compliance from the Maintenance team regarding safe execution promoting a safe work

**TECHNICAL**

* Execute hands on maintenance activities for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and test activities.
* Provide maintenance and technical support during the commissioning of the rotating equipment.
* Maintain accurate document control and monitor quality assurance initiatives to maintain history.
* Must be able to read and interpret vibration spectrums.
* Ensure that all the vibration, temperature and rod drop probes are set correctly and functional.
* Analyze the process parameters from DCS trends with the intent of predicting future failures and rotating equipment performance.
* The ability to troubleshoot the root cause of failures based on operating conditions and apply the correct maintenance required.
* Apply and demonstrate knowledge in both laser and DTI alignment techniques.
* Ensure that any alignment temperature compensating factors are applied for hot applications.
* Ensure that holt bolting is applied to piping systems for hot applications.
* Apply and demonstrate knowledge in measuring out and coaching the team to conduct piston bumping clearance, crank shaft deflection, crankcase deflection, piston run-out corrections, crosshead guide alignment, journal and main bearing to crank shaft clearance measurements.
* Initiate an inspection program focusing on the critical equipment vibration, temperature and pressure monitoring by completing a daily/weekly inspection sheet. These deviations to be noted and work requests to be created in SAP.
* Provide maintenance input for scheduled outages to ensure effective planning and execution
* Assist in the development and execute the preventative / predictive maintenance program to ensure scheduled maintenance activities are completed and remain in compliance.
* In cooperation with Engineering execute a reliability program to achieve operational excellence by sustaining equipment operation and drive productivity to increase efficiency.
* Achieve the best MTBF, MTTR and reliability metrics related to rotating equipment.
* Development of work instructions for ease of reference and execution for the maintenance team.
* Provide input for the critical spares inventory and follow-up on delivery and lead times.
* Provide input into the execution plan for the major PM overhauls during the shutdowns and TAR
* Ensure compliance with the condition monitoring program by following up with Engineering on the trends analysis and corrective actions.
* To complete technical reports of all major repairs and PM overhauls for critical rotating equipment.
* To develop a shared folder with all rotating equipment, specifications, spares, special tools, repairs and major overhauls including RCAs and MOCs.
* To maximize the availability and safety of critical compression assets while minimizing unplanned downtime in production environments.
* Applying asset management techniques to monitor the integrity of the critical equipment on-line run time by applying condition monitoring techniques for vibration, temperature and packing leakage rates. This information must be logged and analyzed to implement corrective actions before catastrophic failures with the objective of increasing the life cycle of the equipment.
* Verify and conduct piping strain corrections and confirm that vibration dampeners, supports and grouting are in good condition.
* Be able to overhaul cryogenic services oxygen pumps and maintain a clean room for oxygen service as part of primary responsibility.
* Must be able to handle, assemble and install mechanical seals and have the ability to identify the failure modes.
* Must be able to handle and co-ordinate the removal, installation and repairs to dry gas seals.
* Must be familiar with the different mechanical seal plans and their required maintenance to ensure the effective function of the mechanical seals.
* Ensure that the tools, nitrogen and gauge manifolds are available to measure the bladder nitrogen pressure for the pulsation dampeners.
* Develop a toolbox for each critical equipment ensuring that all the special tools and consumables are available to conduct maintenance. The toolboxes must be repacked and restored with all tools and consumables before placing in the store after each overhaul. 
* Ensure the safety of all maintenance personnel by utilizing the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program, which includes Safety Work Permits, LOTO, Confined Space, etc.  The position is a key member in building the Air Products safety culture into the BHIG.
* Understand Environmental Regulatory requirements and contain all oil spillages and dispose correctly.
* Ensure Air Products and BHIG standards, and best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and overall customer services are met. In some cases, the safety objectives for SATORP and SASREF will be applicable.
* Monitor and execute preventative and corrective maintenance activities pertaining to the rotating equipment, to ensure operation and reliability targets are achieved.
* Maintain equipment maintenance document integrity through accurate technical reports. Ensure that the protocols and QCPs are completed for all rotating equipment overhauls.
* Supervise and coordinate rotating service providers with all site related activities, ensuring the focus is on quality and reliability.
* Coordinating with the operations and engineering teams to rectify rotating equipment issues and implementing cost effective solutions.
* Achieve and maintain operations excellence and customer satisfaction through maintenance productivity, reliability, quality, and cost reduction efforts.
* Provide maintenance support and participate in incident investigations and root cause analysis.  Identify and implement sustainable corrective action(s).
* Leading the rotating activities during turnarounds (TAR), including, preparation of job packages, spares and materials, contractors and tools and safety management during execution.
* Support on-call activities when required and help with rotating recommendations outside of normal working hours when consulted.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Must have at least 15 years demonstrated competency in oil and gas industry on rotating equipment which includes reciprocating, centrifugal, screw, lobe and diaphragm compressors.
* Must have demonstrated knowledge and experience in oil and gas industry of leading reciprocating, centrifugal and screw compressor overhauls.
* Must have hands-on experience working with reciprocating compressors and pump overhauls.
* Must have knowledge and be able to overhaul cryogenic pumps especially in oxygen service, centrifugal pumps, positive displacement pumps, high‑speed integral pumps (e.g., Sundyne LMV models), screw, gear, and dosing pumps.
* Must be able to understand, apply and achieve all the reliability metrics regarding rotating equipment.
* Must have at least 10 years’ experience in a Leadership, Supervisory and Management role in therotating equipment maintenance environment.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent in mechanical engineering or maintenance management in rotating equipment is desirable.
* Vibration level 1 and 2 certification will be advantageous.
* Must be able to manage a team’s development ensuring that proper IDPs are in place, implemented and monitored to improve the team’s rotating equipment knowledge and competence.
* Must be able to coach and mentor the team by leading the equipment overhauls and ensuring effective knowledge transfer.

job_title: Sales And Education Manager - Sol de Janeiro - Riyadh
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalyzed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.  

**What you'll be doing**

As Sales Manager for KSA, you will be the face of Sol de Janeiro in the Saudi market, owning the in-store performance, brand experience, and education. You'll spend most of your time in the field, visiting doors, coaching beauty advisors, driving sell-out, and bringing the joyful experiences of Sol de Janeiro to life. You'll also play a key role in supporting consumer activations, PR events, and retailer animations across the region.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

  *Retail & Sell-Out*

* Visit Sephora on a structured cycle to ensure brand standards, visibility, and merchandising excellence.
    
* Drive sell-out performance against monthly and quarterly targets, identifying opportunities at door level.
    
* Monitor stock levels, testers, and visual merchandising compliance, flagging issues to the KAM.
    
* Build strong relationships with store managers, beauty advisors, and retailer field teams
    

*Education*

* Deliver product training and brand storytelling sessions to beauty advisors, both in-store and during retailer education days.
    
* Coach BAs on the Sol de Janeiro selling techniques, hero products, big bets and seasonal launches.
    

*Consumer Engagement & PR*

* Support consumer-facing activations, in-store events, and animations across KSA.
    
* Provide on-ground support for PR events, influencer activations, and brand experiences.
    
* Coordinate logistics with retailer marketing teams and external agencies as needed.
    

*Reporting & Collaboration*

* Provide regular sell-out reports, competitive intelligence, and field feedback to the KAM in Paris
    
* Travel to Dubai for client meetings, regional reviews, and team alignment sessions
    
* Represent the voice of the KSA market within the wider Middle East strategy
    

**Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in sales or account management within beauty, or premium/luxury FMCG, ideally in KSA and/or UAE.
    
* Strong knowledge of the KSA beauty market
    
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and growing key accounts.
    
* Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and in-store execution skills.
    
* Willingness to travel extensively across KSA and periodically to Dubai
    
* Fluent English and Arabic required.
    
* Self-starter, comfortable working autonomously and reporting to a remote manager
    
* Based in KSA; valid driving license.
    
* Microsoft Package knowledge.
    

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.  We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

Role Overview The DevOps & Release Management Engineer is the gatekeeper of our production environment, responsible for architecting and executing the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) strategy across our entire financial technology ecosystem. You will ensure seamless, zero-downtime releases for our core platforms (Fineract and ERPNext) alongside our proprietary custom stack (mobile applications, Java/Spring Boot middleware, credit decision engine, and BPM workflows). Operating entirely within Google Cloud Platform (GCP KSA), you will champion infrastructure-as-code (IaC), container orchestration, and strict release governance to meet the high-availability demands of the KSA financial sector. Key Responsibilities Release Planning & Governance • Own the Release Management lifecycle: schedule, coordinate, and manage releases across development, QA, UAT, and production environments. • Define and enforce strict release gates, change management controls, and rollback procedures to ensure system stability and compliance with SAMA regulatory requirements. • Maintain comprehensive audit trails of all deployments and infrastructure changes for compliance and security reviews. CI/CD Pipeline Architecture • Design, build, and maintain robust automated CI/CD pipelines for a diverse tech stack, accommodating monolithic packaged applications (ERPNext) and modern microservices. • Automate testing integration, code quality checks, and security scanning within the deployment pipelines for custom-built middleware, mobile apps, and decision engines. • Manage environment consistency and configuration drift across all tiers. Cloud Infrastructure & Container Orchestration • Manage and scale the underlying GCP infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform). • Administer and optimize Kubernetes (K8s) clusters for the deployment of proprietary microservices, ensuring efficient resource utilization, auto-scaling, and high availability. • Manage service meshes, API gateways, and identity/access management configurations (e.g., Keycloak) critical to the middleware's security architecture. Monitoring & Operations Support • Implement advanced telemetry, logging, and monitoring solutions across the GCP environment (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) to proactively detect post-release anomalies. • Collaborate closely with the ITSM Lead and L3 Engineering to troubleshoot deployment failures, database migration issues (e.g., PostgreSQL), and complex network routing problems. Requirements Qualifications & Technical Requirements • Experience: 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and Release Management, ideally within banking, fintech, or a highly regulated industry. • Cloud & Infrastructure: Deep, hands-on expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. • CI/CD & Automation: Proficiency with enterprise CI/CD tools (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD) and configuration management. • Technical Stack Knowledge: • Experience deploying and managing Java (Spring Boot) and Python applications. • Strong understanding of relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL, and handling automated database migrations during releases. • Familiarity with the deployment architectures of Fineract and/or ERPNext (Frappe framework) is highly advantageous. • Scripting: Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python) for automating routine operational tasks. • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, ITIL release management frameworks, and blue/green or canary deployment strategies.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Inspector – Telecom & IT is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality and compliance of telecommunications and IT systems deployed in transportation projects. This includes systems such as fiber optics, CCTV, passenger information systems, and network infrastructure across rail, metro, or bus networks.

## Your role

**Inspection & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct on-site inspection of Telecom & IT systems installations (fiber optic cables, networking equipment, telecom rooms, etc.).
* Ensure all installations comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, and project standards.
* Monitor contractor activities and verify adherence to safety and quality standards.

**Telecom & IT Systems Oversight**

* Inspect systems including:
* Structured cabling systems.
* Fiber optic networks.
* CCTV and surveillance systems.
* Passenger Information Systems (PIS).
* Public Address (PA) systems.
* Access control and security systems.
* Verify testing, commissioning, and integration of systems.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and daily activity logs.
* Review method statements, shop drawings, and material submittals.
* Maintain accurate records of inspection activities and findings.

**Testing & Commissioning Support**

* Witness and validate testing & commissioning activities for telecom and IT systems.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results and system performance.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate with contractors, engineers, and project stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Support project engineers in tracking progress and closing inspection comments.
* Liaise with other disciplines (electrical, civil, systems) for integrated works.

**Education**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, IT, or related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in Telecom & IT inspection, preferably in transportation projects (metro, rail, airport, or ITS).
* Experience working on site supervision or inspection roles.

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of:
    
    Telecom infrastructure and cabling systems.
    
    Networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, switches, routers).
    
    Low current systems (CCTV, access control, PA systems).
    
* Familiarity with:
    
    Testing tools (OTDR, cable testers, network analyzers).
    
    Relevant industry standards (TIA/EIA, ISO, IEC)
    

**Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of transportation systems and operations.
* Familiarity with ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) is an advantage

**Soft Skills**

* Attention to detail and strong observational skills.
* Good communication and reporting abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced site environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in transportation projects or large infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of SCADA, AFC, or signaling system interfaces.
* Certification in telecom/networking (e.g., CCNA) is a plus.
* Familiarity with safety standards and site compliance requirements.

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

Fresha is the leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry, giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships.

Our mission is simple: help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place.
We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us.
Role Overview
Account Manager | Arabic Speaking | Office-based (5 days/week)

Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you’ll build strong relationships with existing partners, understand their businesses and identify opportunities to increase adoption and monetisation of the Fresha platform.

• Upselling & Monetisation: Analyse account performance and identify opportunities to increase product adoption, upsell relevant solutions and grow monetised revenue.

• Partner Relationships: Build strong, long-term relationships with partners through proactive communication, regular video meetings and a deep understanding of their businesses.

• Retention & Engagement: Maintain a consistent contact strategy across your portfolio, keeping partners engaged with Fresha and proactively identifying opportunities to reduce churn.

• Performance & CRM: Consistently achieve commercial targets while keeping account activity, opportunities and next steps accurately recorded in the CRM.

• Partner Experience: Educate partners on the value of the Fresha platform, share relevant insights and ensure they are getting the most from the products and services available to them.

• Commercial Growth: Demonstrable experience managing a large account base and driving revenue growth, upselling and retention across existing customers.

• SaaS & SMB Experience: Experience working in SaaS, technology or a similar commercial environment, ideally selling to or managing SMB customers.

• Communication: Fluent in Arabic and English , with excellent communication, listening and relationship-building skills.

• Results & Initiative: Commercially motivated, target-driven and proactive, with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of your portfolio.

• Organisation & Adaptability: Highly organised with strong time-management skills and comfortable managing multiple accounts in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.

Your Opportunity at Fresha

• Own a Portfolio: Take responsibility for a portfolio of Fresha partners and have a direct impact on retention, monetisation and revenue growth.

• Drive Commercial Growth: Identify opportunities to increase product adoption and help businesses get more value from Fresha.

• Build Strong Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with business owners and decision-makers across the Arabic-speaking market.

• Develop Your Commercial Career: Build your skills across Account Management, upselling, retention and SaaS commercial growth.

• Make an Impact: Your work will directly contribute to partner success and Fresha’s continued growth across global markets.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

We are seeking an experienced AFC Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making within public transportation systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in analyzing fare collection data, passenger behavior, revenue performance, and system efficiency, with a strong understanding of transportation operations.

## Your role

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

Analyze AFC transaction data (smart cards, mobile tickets, contactless payments) to identify trends in ridership, revenue, and passenger flow.

Develop dashboards and reports tracking KPIs such as ridership, fare evasion, peak usage, and revenue leakage.

Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure integrity of AFC datasets.

**Transportation Insights**

Provide insights into passenger travel patterns, route performance, and network utilization.

Support planning teams with demand forecasting and capacity planning.

Analyze multimodal integration (bus, metro, tram) using AFC data.

**Advanced Analytics**

Build predictive models for ridership forecasting, fare optimization, and demand analysis.

Apply statistical techniques and machine learning where applicable.

Conduct scenario analysis to support policy or fare structure changes.

**System & Data Management**

Work with AFC system vendors and internal IT teams to manage data pipelines and integrations.

Extract, transform, and load (ETL) large datasets from AFC systems and data warehouses.

Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

Collaborate with operations, finance, and planning teams to translate data into actionable insights.

Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.

Support audits and regulatory reporting requirements.

## About you

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Transportation Engineering, or related field.
* Master’s degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in data analysis, ideally within public transportation or mobility sectors.
* Proven experience working with AFC systems (e.g., Cubic, Thales, Scheidt & Bachmann, etc.).

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in:
    
    SQL (advanced level).
    
    Python or R for data analysis.
    
    Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
    
* Experience with:
    
    Big data platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) is a plus.
    
    GIS tools (ArcGIS/QGIS) for spatial analysis.
    
    ETL tools and data warehousing concepts.
    

**Domain Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of:
* Public transportation operations.
* Fare structures and ticketing systems.
* Transit KPIs and performance metrics.

Join our professional maritime operations team as Chief Officer aboard our fleet of vessels. This leadership role is responsible for the safe and efficient management of deck operations, cargo and cargo safety, stability and ballasting, safety management system execution, crew supervision, and support to the Master in overall vessel operations. The Chief Officer will report to the Master, coordinate with technical and shore-based teams, and ensure compliance with international conventions and company policies.
Primary Responsibilities for Chief Officer - deck operations, cargo, safety

• The role of the Chief Officer is to manage the Deck Department and to assist the Master in the safe and efficient operation of the vessel.

• In the event of the Master becoming incapacitated, the Chief Officer shall assume the role of the Master.

• Should there is no standalone Safety Officer, the Chief Officer shall assume the role of shipboard Safety Officer.

• The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, deck department maintenance, stability and ballast operations, maintenance of all lifting appliances and the handling and stowage of dangerous cargo including the hazardous materials/ COSHH database and management system.

• Review with client representative new working locations, for gangway connections and lift plans according with IMCA guidelines.

• Ensure IMCA guidelines are followed for Dynamic Positioning Operation, where applicable.

• During anchor handling the Chief Officer is responsible for the planning and organization of the deck crew and of anchor handling equipment.

• Their responsibilities also include the planning of working hours for the deck crew and to monitor that rest hour requirements are complied with.

• Being responsible for the supervision, training, and evaluation of deck personnel. This includes maintaining and administering discipline to deck personnel.

• During their watch (Navigation/Deck), they are responsible for the safety and integrity of the vessel and that relevant procedure for the loading and unloading of attending vessels and helicopters are followed by the appointed personnel.

• They are to ensure that all work on deck is carried out in a safe and efficient manner. This includes responsibility for all entry work in accordance with the Permit to Work System.

• The responsibilities also include reporting as required by Integrated Management System.

• The Chief Officer acts as Stability Section Leader. Ballasting and de-ballasting to and from transit draught are normally carried out by Chief Officer.

• Being responsible for all aspects of the ship’s fire, safety, security and emergency equipment (LSA / FFA). This is to include regular maintenance and training of ship personnel in the use and deployment of all fire, safety, security and emergency equipment.

• Being responsible for refusing unsafe work and for carrying out all work in accordance with the established safety standards and work practices.

• Being responsible for the inventory, requisition, and upkeep of all deck stores according to the vessel’s budget.

• Through consultation with the Chief Engineer, ensuring that all enclosed / confined spaces, restricted areas (as per SSP), tank air vents and filling pipes throughout the vessel are clearly marked and identified.

• Responsible to the Master for the overall cleanliness and good condition of the vessel’s accommodation.

• Maintaining logbooks, sounding books, cargo space records, lifting equipment (including cargo gear) records, and towing equipment records accurately.

• Ensuring that the Garbage Management Plan is fully complied with, and the garbage record book is fully maintained complete with waste disposal receipts.

• Ensuring that all pollution prevention measures are in place and spill response equipment is maintained.

• Ensuring the proper training and conducting of drills and exercises are carried out and officially documented as per SOLAS, ISM Code and ISPS Code requirements and in reference to the Company’s Drill and Training Matrix.

• The sounding of tanks, cofferdams and bilges throughout the vessel at least once per day and the upkeep of the Sounding Records.

• Maintain and monitor the watertight/weathertight integrity of the vessel.

• If there are more than 2 qualified junior watch keeping officers on board, and the vessel is on sea voyages of 7 or more days, the Chief Officer is required to keep at least 1 navigational watch of 4 hours per week at Master’s discretion.

• The Chief Officer acts as second in command in all fire-fighting matters and may be required to act as Team Leader of an emergency team.

• During their watch, they are in charge of all Work carried out by the Deck department under the Permit to Work System and may be required to act as permit co-coordinator.

• The Chief Officer's duties in emergency situations are laid down in the vessel's Emergency Response Manual and/or stated on the Muster List.

• They are to carry out any lawful command as requested by Master.

• The Chief Officer shall co-operate closely with all other officers, with the Engineering Officers, The SDPO´s, the Charterer's Representative and the Camp Boss.

• The allocation of daily work to the deck crew

• Prepare appraisal reports for deck crew, trainee officers(Cadets)

• Advise Master on the performance of deck officers including appraisal reports.

• Responsible for training of deck cadets and is the shipboard training officer onboard (STO)

• Prepare requisitions for deck stores, spares ,paints and reconfirm requisitions as raised by other deck officers prior submission to the Master.

• Receiving and signing for deck stores, spares and paints and to ensure the quality and quantity of items delivered conform to the order.

• Wearing, inspecting and caring for required personal protective equipment.

• Any additional duties as assigned by the Master.

Required Qualifications - master certification, experience, medical fitness

• Certificate of Competency as per STCW reg II.

• STCW endorsements

• Valid Medical certificate

• DP Unlimited License (where applicable)

• DP experience as per IMCA M 117

• Ship Security Officer certificate as per STCW Regulation VI/5

• Minimum 12 months of experience in rank and similar type of vessel.

Preferred Skills - cargo specialization, leadership, technical aptitude

• Experience with offshore support vessels, AHTS, tanker, or energy-sector operations, including specialty cargo systems and dynamic cargo operations.

• Training in advanced cargo handling, stability management, tankerman procedures, and leadership or supervisory courses that enhance onboard team performance.

• Familiarity with electronic cargo planning tools, stability software, and bridge systems to support integrated operational decision-making.

• Demonstrated leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop and retain competent deck personnel and maintain safe, efficient operations.

Work Environment & Conditions - seafaring life, rotations, safety

• Seagoing leadership position with rotational deployments; assignments may include extended periods onboard with defined on/off rotation schedules.

• Work in offshore, port, and confined-space environments; ability to operate safely around moving machinery, at heights, and during adverse weather conditions when required.

• Must comply with medical fitness standards, vaccinations, and company pre-employment screening and certification verification processes.

Compensation & Benefits - competitive pay, seafarer benefits, development

• Competitive salary and marine benefits aligned with industry standards for Chief Officers in the energy and commercial vessel sectors.

• Comprehensive health coverage, life insurance, paid leave, retirement/savings plans, and repatriation benefits per company policy.

• Opportunities for professional development, leadership training, onboard instruction, and career progression to Master or shore-based management roles.

How to Apply - application process, documentation
Submit a detailed CV/resume highlighting relevant chief officer or senior deck officer sea service, certifications, endorsements, and recent sea service records. Include copies of key certifications, medical certificates, and contact information for professional references. Qualified applicants will be contacted for screening interviews, competency assessments, and practical evaluations.

Deck

description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
As a Managing Partner (MP), you will act as the primary leader responsible for building deep, value-driven strategic relationships with one of SAP's most important customers in the Energy and Oil & Gas industry. Based in Saudi Arabia, you will develop an in-depth understanding of the customer's business, market dynamics, and transformation priorities — including upstream, downstream, and corporate operations — leveraging a strong internal SAP network and partner ecosystem.
By executing the Strategic Customer Program (SCP) Methodology, you will deliver differentiated value, drive customer success, and enable long-term business and digital transformation across one of the world's largest integrated energy companies.
What you will do
+ Drive deep, trusted relationships with customer C-level executives and senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment between their strategic business priorities and SAP's Energy and Oil & Gas solutions.
+ Define and co-create a strategic roadmap focused on sustainable business outcomes, digital transformation, upstream and downstream operations modernization, asset performance management, and operational excellence.
+ Lead the execution of the SAP Strategic Customer Program (SCP) by orchestrating a cross-functional Extended Account Team, ensuring a unified 'one-team' approach across all customer touchpoints — including corporate, upstream, downstream, and affiliate entities.
+ Foster a high-performance culture based on collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, identifying new opportunities to create value and drive growth across the full spectrum of Energy and Oil & Gas operations.
+ Establish and facilitate multi-level governance frameworks that align SAP, SAP Ecosystem, technology partners, and customer leadership to deliver measurable business impact across a complex, globally integrated organisation.
+ Support the expansion of SAP's footprint by leveraging the full SAP solution portfolio — including S/4HANA, SAP BTP, EAM, IBP, and Sustainability solutions — working closely with system integrators, hyperscalers, technology partners, and strategy consulting firms serving the Energy sector.
+ Collaborate with the Account Executive and extended VAT team to drive sales execution, with a strong focus on net bookings and cloud revenue growth through strategic account planning, business development, and strong adoption outcomes across corporate and affiliate entities.
+ Manage and increase adoption and consumption of SAP Cloud services, while protecting and growing overall cloud revenues across one of SAP's most strategic global accounts.
+ Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with senior executives, reviewing KPIs, value realization, mutual commitments, and future growth opportunities — including alignment with national energy transition and Vision 2030 objectives.
+ Proactively track and anticipate M&A activity, joint ventures, and new energy investments within the customer landscape to position SAP early, maximize commercial impact, and drive internal alignment and accountability.
What you bring
+ Strong background in strategic account leadership, Energy and Oil & Gas industry expertise, and business acumen, with the ability to translate complex industry challenges — including upstream operations, downstream processing, and corporate digital transformation — into actionable, value-based roadmaps.
+ Proven ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships across large, complex, government-linked organisations and implement effective governance models.
+ Deep expertise in value-based selling and strategic decision-making in large, complex enterprise environments, including experience navigating multi-stakeholder government and semi-government organisations.
+ Solid understanding of SAP solutions and their application within the Energy and Oil & Gas industry, with excellent communication and executive-level presentation skills, including leading QBRs.
+ Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable business results, consistently exceeding net booking and cloud revenue targets within the Energy sector.
+ Experience working across complex, multinational and government-linked organisations, delivering Energy industry insights and best practices to support innovation, efficiency, decarbonisation, and long-term growth.
Languages
+ Fluent Arabic: a strong advantage
+ Fluent English: required
+ Existing executive relationships with the customer: a strong advantage
Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

Alnafitha is seeking a Senior Active Directory Engineer to deliver managed operations and to support a major identity change initiative for a banking client in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working as the on-site technical liaison between the client and the global office, the engineer ensures the stability, security, and compliance of the client’s Active Directory environment while executing planned modernization work (such as forest consolidation, domain migration, schema upgrades, and security hardening) in parallel with business-as-usual operations.  

# Key Responsibilities  

**Operational Stability & Health Management (Daily / Weekly)**  

•      Monitor Active Directory health, including replication, FSMO roles, SYSVOL, event logs, and domain controller performance.  

•      Perform daily health checks (DCDIAG, REPADMIN, NETDIAG) and carry out proactive remediation.  

•      Manage DNS hygiene, including scavenging, stale records, and DNSSEC where used.  

•      Manage time synchronisation, ensuring the PDC emulator points to a reliable NTP source.  

•      Ensure backup success (system state and full forest) and periodically test restores.  

•      Apply OS, security, and AD cumulative updates during approved maintenance windows.  

**Support the “Change” Initiative (Project Mode, in parallel with BAU)**  

•      Participate in joint planning with the global office and local bank teams to define the change (e.g., forest consolidation, domain migration, schema upgrade, security overhaul, site topology redesign).  

•      Deploy new domain controllers or upgrade existing ones.  

•      Modify site links, subnets, and replication schedules.  

•      Restructure OUs and move objects (users, computers, groups) using tools such as ADMT, PowerShell, and Quest.  

•      Implement new GPOs or refactor existing ones.  

•      Configure or reconfigure forest and domain trusts.  

•      Migrate service accounts to gMSA wherever possible.  

•      Perform pre-change validation in a lab or staging environment.  

•      Execute change during approved maintenance windows (nights / weekends, respecting banking hours).  

•      Validate post-change health and roll back if success criteria are not met.  

**Security & Compliance Hardening (Ongoing)**  

•      Maintain an AD security baseline aligned with CIS / NIST and banking regulations (FFIEC, PCI, SWIFT CSP).  

•      Manage and monitor privileged groups (Enterprise Admins, Domain Admins, Schema Admins) for unauthorized changes.  

•      Review and clean up stale users, computers, and service accounts monthly.  

•      Enforce Kerberos AES encryption, restrict NTLM, and enable LDAP signing and channel binding.  

•      Manage and rotate service account credentials (LAPS for local admins, gMSA for services).  

•      Assist with privileged access management (PAWs, JIT, break-glass accounts).  

•      Ensure audit policies forward logs to the SIEM (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and investigate anomalies.  

**Collaboration with the Global Office**  

•      Act as the technical liaison between the global AD team and local bank operations.  

•      Participate in weekly design / status calls with the global office during the major change initiative.  

•      Translate global AD standards into local implementation plans.  

•      Report on local environment health, risks, and change progress using agreed dashboards.  

•      Escalate issues requiring global decisions (e.g., schema changes, cross-forest trust policies).  

**Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution**  

•      Diagnose and resolve AD-related incidents, including authentication failures, replication breaks, GPO application issues, account lockouts, and Kerberos errors.  

•      Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.  

•      Support application teams with AD integration issues (SPN misconfigurations, delegation, permissions).  

•      Participate in security incident response where AD compromise is suspected (e.g., golden ticket, DCSync attacks).  

**Documentation & Knowledge Transfer (Local team and global office)**  

•      Maintain living documentation: AD topology, domain controller inventory, FSMO locations, site links, GPO inventory, privileged group memberships, and service account lists.  

•      Document all changes performed during the major change initiative, including before / after states.  

•      Produce troubleshooting runbooks for common AD issues tailored to the bank’s environment.  

•      Provide training sessions for local junior admins and global office teams as needed.  

**Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity**  

•      Maintain and test AD forest recovery procedures.  

•      Ensure backup integrity and off-site / air-gapped copies for ransomware resilience.  

•      Participate in annual DR drills with global and local teams.  

**Reporting & Metrics**  

•      Provide status reports to the local IT manager and global office as required, covering health metrics, change progress, security findings, incidents, and planned activities.  

•      Track and report KPIs: domain controller uptime, replication latency, authentication success rate, backup success rate, stale object reduction, and audit log coverage.  

  

  

### Requirements

# Qualifications & Experience  

•      Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  

•      5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Active Directory environments, ideally in banking, financial services, or other regulated sectors.  

•      Proven experience delivering AD migration, consolidation, or modernization projects.  

•      Experience operating within change management and approved maintenance windows in a 24/7 production environment.  

# Technical Skills  

•      Deep expertise in Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and Kerberos / NTLM authentication.  

•      Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.  

•      Hands-on experience with migration tooling such as ADMT and Quest Migration Manager.  

•      Knowledge of AD security hardening (LAPS, gMSA, tiered administration, PAW, JIT) and frameworks (CIS, NIST).  

•      Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar) and audit log forwarding.  

•      Experience with backup / recovery and AD forest recovery procedures.  

•      Working knowledge of hybrid identity (Entra ID / Azure AD Connect) is a plus.  

# Certifications (Preferred)  

•      Microsoft certifications (e.g., MCSE, Identity and Access Administrator) preferred.  

•      Security certifications such as Security+, GIAC, or CISSP are an advantage.  

# Core Competencies  

•      Strong analytical and root-cause troubleshooting skills.  

•      Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is a plus.  

•      Ability to work with global and local stakeholders across time zones.  

•      Discretion and reliability appropriate to a regulated banking environment.  

# Working Conditions  

•      Standard working week is Sunday to Thursday during normal working hours.  

•      Annual leave is provided in accordance with KSA labor law.  

•      Work required outside normal working hours or days is treated as overtime; overtime cost is settled with the monthly invoice.
